title: Choose Campus Circle’s visual world
question: Which interface should carry the full student portal?

options.label: The Pocket Field Guide
options.lineage: student planners, trail guides, and annotated campus maps
options.thesis: Campus life becomes a compact field guide where every listing is a useful, checkable lead.
options.viewport: A dense but calm Today board leads with three category routes, fresh listings, and a privacy status strip that reads like an annotated guide page.
options.risk: The paper language must stay precise or it can drift into scrapbook decoration.

raised.raise: Every category and state now has strict, repeatable wayfinding color rules.
Time-sensitive listings earn a live, ranked rhythm instead of a generic card grid.

options.label: The Community Noticeboard
options.lineage: well-kept library corkboards and student union notices
options.thesis: A familiar shared board makes posting, scanning, and responding feel immediately communal.
options.viewport: Pinned notices form a strong editorial composition around a central post action and three clearly separated boards.
options.risk: It is the most familiar direction and could resemble other community marketplaces.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Housing, goods, and rides become three unmistakable destinations in a rigorously signed system.
options.viewport: Monumental category bands route students directly into live results with distance, time, and status visible at a glance.
options.case: It wins on task clarity and remains highly legible on phones, but feels less specifically student-made.
options.risk: The airport association can make the marketplace feel too institutional.

options.label: The Live Concourse
options.thesis: All activity is ranked as a changing departures board.
options.viewport: Rows of expiring listings update in place across fixed columns.
options.case: Excellent for rides and expiry, but housing and marketplace browsing need richer imagery and softer pacing.
options.kept: Time-sensitive information now has a disciplined ranked rhythm.
options.risk: A single table grammar becomes exhausting across every workflow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished contemporary marketplace dashboard with familiar filters and cards.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional navigation bar, search hero, category tabs, and responsive listing grid.
canonCard.risk: Clear and usable, but visually indistinguishable from many marketplace products.
